messages.subject: new object of class 'MSProcessedImagingExperiment'
parts:
Hello everyone, 
I changed a bit data in my original file and then tried to rebuild new file:
mz <- mz(new_file)[merge_mz]
coord <- data.frame(x = new_file@elementMetadata@coord@listData[["x"]],
                         y = new_file@elementMetadata@coord@listData[["y"]])
data <- as.matrix(spectra(new_file)[merge_mz,])
idata <- ImageArrayList(data)
fdata <- MassDataFrame(mz=mz)
pdata <- PositionDataFrame(coord=coord)
test <- MSImagingExperiment(
  imageData=idata,
  featureData=fdata,
  pixelData=pdata)

But when I plotted new file, spectra looked as connected points of peaks (red lines, blue ones - original file)
Is it possible to create a new file in the same class to be able to draw spectra?
